title: Carousel on desktop, /prueba-carrusel-movil/ at 1512: the landscape photo, and ONE preload of slide 2 with its srcset and sizes, downloaded once at High
description: estrategia-web/carousel with mobileRatio "4/5" and preloadSlides 2 at 1512 px: the usual landscape photo is downloaded (not the crop); the carries ONE for slide 2, with exactly the srcset and sizes of its (not slide 1, which has fetchpriority already), and slide 2's photo is downloaded ONCE at High priority (Chromium's initial priority, recorded by the runner). Seen red (16-10-2026, 28-10-2026) with preload_config() never preloading. The capture waits until every photo request has finished. Read by browser-carousel-crop-desktop. It was part of ./images.mjs, run by carousel.test.mjs (level 3), until 29-10-2026.

steps.expression: (() => { const first = [...document.querySelectorAll('.estrategia-web-carousel')][0]?.querySelectorAll('.estrategia-web-carousel__track img') ?? []; return first.length && [...first].slice(0, 3).every((i) => i.complete && i.currentSrc); })()

values.inspect: (() => ({ preloads: [...document.head.querySelectorAll('link[rel="preload"][as="image"]')].map((l) => ({ media: l.getAttribute('media'), priority: l.getAttribute('fetchpriority'), srcset: l.getAttribute('imagesrcset'), sizes: l.getAttribute('imagesizes') })), carousels: [...document.querySelectorAll('.estrategia-web-carousel')].map((carousel) => ({ label: carousel.getAttribute('aria-label'), images: [...carousel.querySelectorAll('.estrategia-web-carousel__track img')].map((img) => { const r = img.getBoundingClientRect(); const t = carousel.querySelector('.estrategia-web-carousel__track').getBoundingClientRect(); return { alt: img.alt, loading: img.getAttribute('loading'), priority: img.getAttribute('fetchpriority'), sizes: img.getAttribute('sizes'), srcset: img.getAttribute('srcset'), marker: img.hasAttribute('data-estrategia-web-carousel'), src: img.currentSrc, natural: [img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight], width: r.width, visible: r.right > t.left + 1 && r.left < t.right - 1 && r.top < innerHeight, inPicture: img.parentElement.tagName === 'PICTURE', media: img.parentElement.querySelector('source')?.getAttribute('media'), source: img.parentElement.querySelector('source')?.getAttribute('srcset') }; }), })), }))()
